decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and keeping a software component that fits the firm's integration platform costs little.
The open GIS framework is still only mentioned and its prospects remain uncertain, but it is core to the firm's open, extensible strategy and cheap to maintain, so the option is worth keeping open.

The identity service got its own page with a sharper value proposition about integrating into existing user management systems, which shows positive resolution of uncertainty and justifies further commitment.
The consulting workshop launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so its value is still unresolved, and it costs little because it draws on the firm's existing consultants and certified trainers.
